title: One signer sent twice meets a threshold of two
rootCause: Consensus.checkSignatures compares the number of signatures with the threshold and verifies each one, without checking that the signers differ, so a single signer can meet any threshold by repeating itself.

poc.observable: test_one_signer_twice_does_not_meet_a_threshold_of_two fails with "one signer does not count twice"
